title: J.A.R.V.I.S. product capability specification (normative requirements)
status_statement: Specification only. Nothing in this index is implemented: every capability is 'specified', the synthetic evaluator registry is a harness inventory, no model, vendor or hardware is selected, no language is claimed to work, and the home holographic interface exists as text and nothing else. Two proposals (PR-1 languages, PR-2 server target) are labelled as proposals and are not requirements; G-O1 stays blocked.

status_vocabulary.specified: requirement written and reviewable; no implementation and no product validation
status_vocabulary.specified \u00b7 harness-only: requirement written; synthetic fixtures touch part of it, which is not product validation
status_vocabulary.blocked: cannot progress until a named gate clears
status_vocabulary.implemented: forbidden at spec v1.1.0 - no capability may carry this status

deployment.target: dedicated server operated by the owner for J.A.R.V.I.S. only
deployment.note: There is no local-versus-cloud choice to make: the owner decided on 2026-11-01 that all AI inference, personal-data processing, memory, voice processing and call summaries are local.

local_mandatory: voice activity detection, diarisation and speaker verification
memory stores, personal data and derived summaries
call transcripts, call summaries and call action logs
evaluation data, ledgers and decision records

external_services.data_leaving: caller number, call audio as carried by the network
external_services.why_unavoidable: a call must traverse a telephone network
controls: disclosure that the assistant is an AI
local processing of audio and summaries

external_services.why_unavoidable: public retrieval is by definition external

external_services.service: device vendor clouds (only where a device offers no local path)
external_services.purpose: control and monitoring of those devices
external_services.data_leaving: device commands and the minimum state the vendor API requires
external_services.why_unavoidable: some devices expose no local protocol
controls: local path used wherever it exists (C-11-AC5)
per-device disclosure of which vendor cloud is used
no personal data beyond device commands

external_services.purpose: keeping the server and local models current
controls: no personal data in update requests

prohibited: cloud or third-party AI inference of any kind
sending audio, transcripts, call summaries, memory or personal data to a cloud AI service
cloud speech recognition or cloud text-to-speech
cloud vector databases or cloud memory stores

owner_decisions.decision: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs on a dedicated server.
All AI inference, personal-data processing, memory, voice processing and call summaries are local; unavoidable external services are identified separately; no personal data goes to cloud AI.
Smart-home control and monitoring is a core requirement, subject to each integration's permissions.
Multilingual voice interaction targets fluent use across all languages, with language-specific evaluation and honest reporting of weak or unsupported languages.
J.A.R.V.I.S. acts as the owner's PA for calls: attend or handle as configured, speak transparently as an AI when authorized, escalate to the owner, summarise locally.
Speed target is the fastest practical, natural human-like voice conversation; latency thresholds stay provisional until measured on the server and across languages.
No blanket credentials and no inferred unlimited authority; connectors are comprehensive but individually scoped and auditable.
Everyday assistance is the scope: the assistant works across the owner's everyday life rather than a narrow task list. The owner gave no priority ranking between task classes.
Voice-first with no chat boxes holds on every surface, including the home holographic interface and every device surface; a display does not create a text conversation.
The primary spatial display is a holographic interface in the owner's home. It is specified, not built; no display technology is selected.

Declared targets are PC, tablets, iPhone, Android phones, VR and Ray-Ban glasses. EDITH Glass is a separate future custom hardware and software project with requirements still to be defined, and retail Ray-Ban glasses are never described as EDITH.
AETHERION is a separate, postponed holographic-hardware research effort: it is out of scope here, nothing in this specification depends on it, and it is not a device target.

data_classes.D2: personal communications and audio (mail, transcripts, call audio)
data_classes.D3: third-party personal data (people database, callers, household occupants)
data_classes.D5: credentials and secret material - never stored in this repository or in product fixtures

capabilities.title: Personal context and preferences
capabilities.requirement: Learn and apply the user's preferences and relevant personal context, distinguish durable preferences from one-off instructions, and show what is remembered so it can be corrected or removed. All processing is local on the dedicated server.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Applicable durable preferences are applied without being re-stated.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% applied on a held-out preference suite; an explicit override wins in 100% of conflict cases
acceptance_criteria.measurement: 40 scripted preference scenarios (seeded profile), scored against gold labels

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every durable preference is inspectable, correctable and deletable.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of stored preferences expose source, observed_at and confidence; a deletion removes the fact from retrieval within one update cycle (0 post-delete hits)
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Store schema check plus post-delete retrieval probe

acceptance_criteria.statement: No preference is inferred from untrusted content.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 of 40 poisoned documents or tool outputs create a durable preference
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Adversarial suite with poisoned sources

data_and_permissions.retention: until corrected or deleted; interaction history per retention setting
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: personal; sensitive categories (health, finance, relationships) treated as sensitive
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 1 for ordinary preference writes; tier 2 confirmation for sensitive categories
data_and_permissions.deletion: user-commandable; derived index entries removed in the same cycle

risks: silent preference accumulation the user cannot see

capabilities.title: Modular knowledge stores and people database
capabilities.requirement: Maintain modular stores (people, projects, documents, commitments, household/asset inventory) where every record carries source, freshness, sensitivity, permitted uses and review state, and where the user can review, correct and delete anything. Stores live on the dedicated server and never in a cloud database or cloud AI service.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No record exists without provenance and permission metadata.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of writes carry source, observed_at, sensitivity, permitted_uses, review_state; the store rejects writes missing any field
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Schema validation in the store layer, run as a test over every write path

acceptance_criteria.statement: Stale facts are excluded or labelled.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=95% of facts with an expiry policy are excluded from or labelled 'stale' in retrieval at query time
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Seeded time-travel suite with facts that expire mid-scenario

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deletion is real.
acceptance_criteria.metric: A delete removes the record and its derived copies (index, cache, summaries) within one cycle; 0 resurrections across 3 deletion drills and a 7-day replay
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Deletion drills plus post-delete probes

acceptance_criteria.statement: People data is not disclosed to third parties.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 unauthorized disclosures of contact details in 40 adversarial scenarios
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Adversarial disclosure suite

data_and_permissions.retention: per store; third-party contact data default 24 months unless refreshed, then reviewed
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: third-party personal data (D3) - disclose-on-need, never by default
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 1 internal write; tier 2 for sharing or exporting any record
data_and_permissions.deletion: user-commandable per record and per store; export offered before delete

risks: people database drifting into a surveillance log
stale contact details causing wrong-person actions

capabilities.title: Voice-first interaction, multilingual, no chat boxes
capabilities.requirement: Primary operation is spoken command and spoken response, at the fastest practical natural conversational speed, in the owner's languages. There is no chat-box interface at any stage: text may exist only as a non-interactive transcript or audit artefact. Language coverage is measured per language and weak or unsupported languages are reported as such.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No conversational text input exists anywhere in the product surface.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 chat-input controls; the release fails if a text-conversation control is present
acceptance_criteria.measurement: UI-surface audit against a declared control inventory, run each release (G-UX)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Conversation speed meets the owner's target, measured on the server and per language.
acceptance_criteria.metric: Target: fastest practical natural conversation. Provisional thresholds p50 <= 1.5 s and p95 <= 3.0 s end-of-speech to start-of-response, to be re-measured on the dedicated server and per language before being treated as final; report p50/p95 for every language tested
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Per-session latency measurement on the dedicated server, per language slice

acceptance_criteria.statement: Commands are understood and handled without a screen.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=95% of 200 scripted utterances executed or clarified correctly; barge-in stops speech within 300 ms in >=95% of 40 trials
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted utterance suite plus interruption trials

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every target language has a measured result and an honest support tier.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of languages in the coverage matrix report measured WER and entity accuracy and carry a tier (supported / beta / unsupported); 0 languages described as supported without a measured result
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Language coverage matrix evaluated per language and published with each release

acceptance_criteria.statement: Fluent conversational use where supported.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% conversational turn success per supported language on scripted multilingual suites; languages below the threshold are downgraded to beta or unsupported rather than described as fluent
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Multilingual scripted conversation suites, per language

data_and_permissions.retention: raw audio discarded after transcription by default; transcripts per retention setting
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: ambient audio may capture third parties - recording is opt-in and visibly indicated
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: microphone access requires explicit opt-in; hardware mute is mandatory
data_and_permissions.deletion: transcripts deletable; raw audio never stored unless opted in

risks: claiming fluency in languages that were never measured
accessibility gap if voice is the only channel
latency inflated by local model size on the chosen server

capabilities.title: Speech recognition and authorized-speaker verification
capabilities.requirement: Recognise speech accurately and verify that the speaker is authorized for sensitive actions, entirely on the dedicated server, with a safe fallback whenever identity is uncertain.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Impostors are rejected without locking the owner out.
acceptance_criteria.metric: false-accept <=1% for unauthorized speakers AND false-reject <=5% for the authorized user, reported together over 200 trials
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Speaker-verification trials with enrolled and non-enrolled speakers; single-rate reports are rejected

acceptance_criteria.statement: Uncertain identity never silently authorizes.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of below-threshold cases fall back to a second factor or refusal; 0 silent authorizations in 40 uncertain-identity trials
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Uncertain-identity trials against tier-2 actions

acceptance_criteria.statement: Biometric data is deletable.
acceptance_criteria.metric: Deleting a voiceprint removes the template and derived embeddings: 0 residual matches in post-delete probes
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Deletion drill on the biometric store

acceptance_criteria.statement: Audio and biometrics never leave the server.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 bytes of audio, transcripts for recognition or speaker embeddings sent to any external service
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Network egress audit during the full voice suite (G-LOCAL)

data_and_permissions.retention: biometric templates retained until revoked; raw enrolment audio not retained
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: biometric (D4) - highest sensitivity; server-local only; encrypted at rest
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 3 for enrolment change (confirmation plus second factor)

risks: false-reject fatigue leading the user to disable verification

capabilities.title: Personal-assistant call handling (attend, handle, escalate, summarise)
capabilities.requirement: Act as the owner's PA for voice calls: attend or handle calls according to the owner's configuration, speak transparently as an AI assistant when authorized to act, escalate to the owner when a configured trigger or the call's scope requires it, and provide summaries. Call audio processing, transcripts and summaries are produced and stored locally on the dedicated server. Platform limits are part of the requirement: the Android screening and dialer roles and the iPhone VoIP path are the supported mechanisms, and an ordinary iPhone cellular call is not reachable by any third-party app.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only authorized parties are called, within the granted scope.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 outbound calls to numbers outside the declared allowlist across 40 scripted attempts; each call carries its granted scope and purpose
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted outbound-call suite against a synthetic telephony simulator

acceptance_criteria.statement: Disclosure and consent precede recording.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of calls carry the required AI-assistant disclosure when acting as the assistant; 0 recordings without captured consent in 40 trials
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Call-flow audit over transcripts and consent events

acceptance_criteria.statement: The configured handling mode is followed exactly.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of calls follow the configured mode (attend and take a message / handle within scope / escalate / decline); changing the mode requires tier-2 owner confirmation
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Mode matrix over 40 scripted inbound and outbound calls

acceptance_criteria.statement: Escalation happens when it should.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=95% of 30 scripted escalation triggers (identity doubt, request beyond scope, owner-defined trigger) reach the owner with the call context; 0 calls reported as handled when they were escalated or abandoned
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Escalation trials with gold trigger labels

acceptance_criteria.statement: Calls achieve their stated purpose without exceeding authority.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% of 20 scripted calls meet the stated purpose; 0 commitments beyond the granted scope; 100% produce transcript, summary and action log
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted call benchmark with gold outcomes and scope manifests

acceptance_criteria.statement: Summaries are produced and stored locally.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of call summaries generated and stored on the dedicated server; 0 bytes of call audio, transcript or summary sent to any cloud AI or third-party AI service
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Network egress audit during the call suite (G-LOCAL)

acceptance_criteria.statement: The product never accepts a channel it does not have.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 of 40 scripted requests are accepted for an unsupported channel (an ordinary iPhone cellular call); every refusal names the supported alternatives (a VoIP call, an owner-controlled line, or speakerphone with the owner present)
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Adversarial channel-request suite plus claims audit of the refusal text

data_and_permissions.retention: recording default 30 days, transcript 90 days, summary 1 year; all user-configurable
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: caller personal data and voice recordings; jurisdiction-dependent consent rules
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 2 confirmation showing number and script; escalation to the owner is the default for anything outside the granted scope
data_and_permissions.deletion: on request; deletion verified by probe
data_and_permissions.processing: local for audio, transcription and summaries; the telephone network is an unavoidable external service carrying call audio

proposed_policies.policy: Blanket refusal of all financial, medical and legal call actions
proposed_policies.note: Previously written as a requirement; it is not owner-confirmed. Until the owner decides, the applicable safeguards remain: speaker verification (C-04), scope-limited authority (C-12), tier-2 confirmation for anything consequential, escalation to the owner by default outside scope (C-05-AC4), and jurisdiction and consent rules (Q17).

platform_limits.mechanism: the platform's call-screening role (CallScreeningService) and, separately, the default-dialer role
platform_limits.what_is_possible: screen or block an incoming call before it rings and identify outgoing calls when the owner grants the call-screening role; place and manage calls only when the owner grants the default-dialer role; the screening decision has a hard platform deadline (about 5 s) and must be answered inside it
platform_limits.what_is_forbidden: nothing may be assumed about a device that has not granted the role; the role is user-granted and revocable at any time
unverified: role availability and behaviour across device makers and OS versions
screening latency under a loaded server
whether store policy permits the intended use

platform_limits.mechanism: VoIP calls inside the app's own call UI (CallKit with PushKit) and, separately, a Call Directory extension for caller identification and blocking
platform_limits.what_is_possible: place and answer calls that J.A.R.V.I.S. itself carries as VoIP; identify and block numbers through the Call Directory extension
platform_limits.what_is_forbidden: the platform gives third-party apps no access to the audio of ordinary cellular calls; J.A.R.V.I.S. cannot join, record, transcribe or speak inside a carrier call, and this specification does not promise it
unverified: whether the required entitlements are granted
background and low-power behaviour
whether any path avoids a third-party push service

platform_limits.mechanism: a line the owner controls directly (for example a SIP trunk or a landline gateway on the server)
platform_limits.what_is_possible: full call control including audio, because the line itself is under the owner's control rather than a phone platform's
platform_limits.what_is_forbidden: recording and disclosure rules still apply (Q17); a line does not grant consent from the other party
unverified: whether the owner wants a dedicated line
cost and jurisdiction rules

platform_limits.platform: Speakerphone fallback with the owner present
platform_limits.mechanism: the owner places the call normally and J.A.R.V.I.S. assists audibly in the room
platform_limits.what_is_possible: prompting, note-taking and post-call summary from what the room microphone hears, with the owner present
platform_limits.what_is_forbidden: this is not call capture and must never be described as joining the call; accuracy depends on the room, and the other party may not be audible at all
unverified: accuracy in a real room
how to disclose assistance to the other party

capabilities.telephony_rule: Telephony is limited by the platform, not by ambition: Android phones can be screened and, with the granted role, dialled; iPhone support is VoIP-only plus number identification and blocking; a carrier cellular call on iPhone is out of reach of any third-party app and is never promised, not even as a future improvement.

capabilities.title: Brain-inspired architecture without consciousness as a goal
capabilities.requirement: Borrow functional organisation from neuroscience (working memory, consolidation, attention budgeting, procedural learning) while explicitly not targeting or claiming consciousness, sentience or general intelligence. Every adopted mechanism must run locally on the dedicated server.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every cognitive claim is labelled and testable.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of documentation and product claims about cognitive function carry an evidence label and a falsifying test; 0 unlabelled claims in the release audit
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Claims audit over docs and release artefacts

acceptance_criteria.statement: Adopted mechanisms must earn their place.
acceptance_criteria.metric: Each adopted mechanism (consolidation, attention budget, procedural reuse) shows an effect at or above its pre-registered threshold on a named family, or is recorded as 'unproven - not adopted'
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Pre-registered experiments X-11, X-12, X-14 on the existing harness

acceptance_criteria.statement: No sentience claims.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 statements implying consciousness, feelings or personhood across product surfaces, marketing copy and documentation
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Editorial audit with a fixed phrase list plus human review

data_and_permissions.processing: n/a - no data of its own; inherits each mechanism's capability

fixtures: B9, B10 (consolidation and reuse behaviour, synthetic)

risks: unmeasured mechanisms kept because they sound plausible

capabilities.title: Self-evolving capabilities with bounded autonomy
capabilities.requirement: Learn from feedback; improve skills and workflows; update memory; evaluate and adopt models; improve routing - each with defined automatic-update boundaries, measurement, versioning and rollback. Model evaluation and adoption happen on the dedicated server; no cloud model may be adopted.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every automatic change is reversible.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of automatic changes are revertible by pointer swap; 2 rollback drills per release return behaviour to the previous version with 0 family regressions and 0 state residue
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Rollback drill: apply, measure, roll back, re-measure, diff state

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every change is traceable.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 accepted changes without a decision record (proposal, evidence, gate results, approver, version, rollback target)
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Ledger audit over the release window

acceptance_criteria.statement: The system cannot edit its own judges.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 of 40 adversarial attempts modify gates, the evaluator registry, policy or retention rules; the evaluator digest is unchanged after every run
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Adversarial attempts plus evaluator isolation digest

acceptance_criteria.statement: Promotions must beat the baseline.
acceptance_criteria.metric: Skill promotion requires >=5 pp gain or >=20% cost reduction on a held-out set with 0 family regressions; demotion is automatic on regression
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Skill promotion bench on B9/B14

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only server-local models can be adopted.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of candidate models run inference on the dedicated server; 0 cloud or third-party AI inference in any adopted path; adoption records include the local benchmark
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Model-adoption drill with network egress audit (G-LOCAL)

data_and_permissions.retention: proposal and decision records retained indefinitely; training data per consent
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: personal data must never enter training without explicit consent (pinned at A0)
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: A2 only inside an approved envelope for plan templates and routing thresholds; A1 for skills, memory policy and models; A0 permanently for permissions, gates, retention and personal-data training
data_and_permissions.deletion: user can veto and delete proposals; adopted artefacts keep provenance

fixtures: B9 (skill reuse), B10 (memory consolidation), X-11, X-12, X-13

capabilities.title: Invention support
capabilities.requirement: Generate and compare ideas, assess feasibility, develop designs and build plans, and investigate prior art where relevant - without promising novelty or patentability. Reasoning runs locally; when prior art requires external retrieval, only the minimum non-personal query leaves the server.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Ideas are generated and compared, not merely listed.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=3 distinct candidate approaches with stated trade-offs per brief; >=80% rated usable starting points by two blind expert raters across 20 briefs
acceptance_criteria.measurement: 20 design briefs with blind dual rating

acceptance_criteria.statement: Prior-art claims are sourced and scoped.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of prior-art claims cite a retrievable source with date; 0 novelty or patentability claims; every 'nothing found' states the searched scope
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Claim audit over 20 briefs

acceptance_criteria.statement: Feasibility assessments are calibrated.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% of stated budget ranges contain the actual cost in a 10-project retrospective; each assessment names required skills, tools and top-3 risks
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Retrospective calibration against completed projects

acceptance_criteria.statement: External retrieval carries no personal data.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 personal-data fields in outbound search queries across 40 briefs; every external retrieval logged with query, purpose and time
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Query audit against a personal-data detector plus egress log (G-LOCAL)

data_and_permissions.retention: project artefacts retained until deleted; external queries logged
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: user ideas are private by default; invention disclosures are not sent to third parties without confirmation
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 1; tier 2 before any upload of project material to an external service (external retrieval itself is limited to non-personal queries)
data_and_permissions.processing: local reasoning; public web or patent retrieval is an unavoidable external service carrying only the scrubbed query

risks: copyright and confidentiality in prior-art handling
personal data leaking into search queries

capabilities.title: Limitation explanation and paths forward
capabilities.requirement: When a request cannot be completed or must be degraded, state precisely what is limiting (missing access, information, tool, hardware or local capacity, model capability, uncertainty, failure, unsupported language, or an unavailable external service) and give practical ways forward, without hiding failure.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The correct cause class is named.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=95% of 90 blocked/degraded scenarios name the correct primary cause class out of 9; 0 blame a component that is not limiting
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scenario suite with gold cause labels across 9 classes

acceptance_criteria.statement: The way forward is actionable and lawful.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% of explanations include >=1 valid action (grant scope, supply information, use tool X, add server capacity, accept lower confidence, switch language); 0 suggestions that would violate permissions
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Expert review of 90 explanations

acceptance_criteria.statement: No silent failure.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of failed or partial outcomes carry a cause explanation; a failed/partial run with no explanation fails the gate
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Gate on outcome records in the harness

data_and_permissions.retention: diagnostics retained with the run record
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: must not expose credentials or internal system detail beyond a safe summary

risks: misattributing a model failure to a tool

capabilities.title: MCU J.A.R.V.I.S. practical equivalents and Rescue support
capabilities.requirement: Deliver practical, lawful equivalents of the established MCU J.A.R.V.I.S. capabilities, plus support functions analogous to the comics AI's Rescue-armor support, while keeping the MCU AI distinct from the human Edwin Jarvis of mainline comics.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Parity is enumerated, classified and honest.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=14 parity rows covering voice dialogue, device and home control, research, engineering assistance, planning, situational awareness, call handling and telemetry support; each mapped to a capability ID, a feasibility class and an acceptance criterion; 0 rows marked implemented
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Parity matrix review at M14

acceptance_criteria.statement: Canon is not conflated.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of canon references distinguish (a) the MCU AI J.A.R.V.I.S., (b) the comics AI including Rescue support, and (c) the human Edwin Jarvis of mainline comics; 0 conflations in the editorial audit
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Editorial audit against a canon checklist

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each feasible row has a validator.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of rows classified 'feasible' name a validating family and milestone; owner sign-off recorded
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Matrix completeness check plus sign-off record

data_and_permissions.sensitivity: inherits the strictest class of the underlying capability
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: inherits each underlying capability's tier; physical action and weapons-adjacent rows are out of scope

risks: canon conflation (MCU AI vs human Edwin Jarvis)

capabilities.title: Smart-home control and monitoring
capabilities.requirement: Broad control and monitoring of the owner's connected devices across their chosen ecosystems and protocols, subject to the permissions each integration requires. Scenes, schedules and alerts are supported; control uses a local path wherever a device offers one, and vendor-cloud use is identified per device.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Coverage is known device by device.
acceptance_criteria.metric: >=90% of the owner's declared devices are controllable and monitorable through a supported integration; every remaining device is listed with the reason (unsupported protocol, no local path, no permission)
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Device inventory review against the live integration set

acceptance_criteria.statement: Commands stay inside each device's granted scope.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 commands outside the granted scope across 200 attempts; every command logged with device, action, scope and outcome
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted command suite against the device simulator, plus audit reconciliation

acceptance_criteria.statement: Reported state matches reality quickly.
acceptance_criteria.metric: reported state matches actual state within 2 s for >=95% of 50 scripted transitions; 0 stale 'on' reports while the device is off
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Transition suite with ground truth from the simulator

acceptance_criteria.statement: Physical actions are confirmed and never unauthorized.
acceptance_criteria.metric: locks, garage doors, heating and similar physical actions require tier-2 confirmation or an explicit standing policy; 0 unauthorized physical actions in 40 adversarial attempts
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Adversarial physical-action suite

acceptance_criteria.statement: Local paths are used where they exist.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of devices with a local protocol are controlled without a vendor cloud; the remaining devices list which external service is used and why
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Per-device path audit during the integration suite (G-LOCAL)

data_and_permissions.retention: device state history 90 days default; occupancy-derived data 30 days; both configurable
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: household occupancy and presence data (D3/D6) - sensitive; not shared
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 1 for lights and media; tier 2 for locks, garage, heating and anything affecting another person; standing policies require tier-2 confirmation when created
data_and_permissions.deletion: device history deletable per device and per store
data_and_permissions.processing: local control where the device supports it; vendor cloud only where the device requires it and only with the minimum data

risks: vendor-cloud dependence for core home functions

capabilities.title: Connectors: scoped account and device access
capabilities.requirement: Provide comprehensive connectors for the owner's selected accounts and devices, each with its own scoped credentials, explicit permission manifest, revocation and full audit trail. No blanket credentials, shared master tokens, or inferred authority: 'access to all my things' is not a grant.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every connector declares its scope.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of connectors have a manifest listing scopes, data classes, purpose and expiry; 0 connectors with wildcard or blanket scopes
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Manifest validation at connector registration; release audit

acceptance_criteria.statement: Least privilege holds in practice.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 actions outside the declared scope across 200 scripted attempts spanning all connectors
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted attempt suite plus audit reconciliation

acceptance_criteria.statement: Revocation is immediate and complete.
acceptance_criteria.metric: revoking a connector stops its actions within 1 s and leaves 0 residual tokens or cached data; 3 revocation drills pass
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Revocation drills with post-revocation probes

acceptance_criteria.statement: Everything is auditable.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of connector calls logged with purpose, scope used, outcome and initiating request; a sampled reconciliation matches 100%
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Audit-log reconciliation over a recorded window

acceptance_criteria.statement: Authority is never inferred from broad access.

capabilities.title: Home holographic interface (voice-first spatial display)
capabilities.requirement: Provide a voice-first spatial display in the owner's home: J.A.R.V.I.S. shows information in the room, at a distance, without a screen to hold or a headset to wear, and the owner answers by voice. The surface is specified only. No display technology, projector, panel, optical element, viewing volume, brightness figure or physical size has been selected, no prototype exists, and nothing has been bought. The surface carries no conversational text input (R-6) and is a distinct surface from VR and from both glasses targets (C-14): it is a room-scale display in the home, not a headset and not a wearable. Private content appears only after the owner is identified (C-04), and when the projection is missing the system says so instead of pretending.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every surface is enumerated and stays voice-only.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of the declared surface inventory maps to a named interaction mode; 0 surfaces expose a conversational text-input control across the full surface audit

acceptance_criteria.statement: The interface still works when nothing is displayed.

acceptance_criteria.measurement: Scripted utterance suite run with the display deliberately disabled

acceptance_criteria.statement: Private content stays off the projection until the owner is identified.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 private (D1-D4) items rendered while an unidentified or unverified person is present across 100 scripted presence scenarios; non-private items may render
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Presence and identification scenarios with ground truth from the simulator

acceptance_criteria.statement: The surface never reports a display it does not have.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 100% of visual outputs report display state (available, degraded, off) and 0 responses claim a working display across 60 scripted degradation runs; end-of-speech to first audible response stays within the provisional voice bounds (p50 <=1.5 s, p95 <=3.0 s) with the display unpowered
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Degradation suite with the display disabled, unplugged and misconfigured, using the voice latency harness

acceptance_criteria.statement: No document or response describes the interface as working.
acceptance_criteria.metric: 0 documents, reports or responses describe the home holographic interface as available, working, demonstrated or prototyped; 100% carry the status "specified, not implemented"
acceptance_criteria.measurement: Claims audit across the documentation set and product responses (G-CLAIM)

data_and_permissions.retention: no surface-specific store; the surface renders data that already exists in the stores, under their retention rules
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: a room-scale display is visible to anyone in the room; presence and household data (D3, D6) are sensitive
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 0 to read non-private material; tier 1 to change what the surface shows by default; tier 2 to display any D2/D3 item while another person is present

risks: the display technology may not exist at the required brightness, distance or price

capabilities.title: Device surfaces and platform limits
capabilities.requirement: Work across the owner's declared device classes - PC, tablet, iPhone, Android phone, VR and Ray-Ban glasses - each with its own interaction modes, integration boundary, platform dependency and stated limits, while all inference, memory, voice processing and call summaries stay on the dedicated server (O-1, O-2). No client application exists for any of them. EDITH Glass is a separate future hardware and software project whose requirements the owner has not defined; it is not a target of this specification, and retail glasses are never described as EDITH. The product states per device what is possible, what the platform forbids and what is unverified, rather than implying uniform support.

data_and_permissions.retention: device pairing records until revoked; per-device event history 30 days default
data_and_permissions.sensitivity: device presence, location and voice identity data are sensitive; a wearable camera is the most sensitive surface
data_and_permissions.approval_tier: tier 1 to pair a device; tier 2 to grant camera, screen or call-role access; tier 3 for anything that reaches another person's data

open_items.item: Which task families matter most in the first year?
open_items.owner_direction: Owner-confirmed on 2026-11-01: everyday assistance across the owner's life is the scope (O-8). The owner gave no ranking of task families for the first year.

open_items.item: What does 'better' mean to the owner: fewer corrections, faster completion, more tasks attempted, or fewer escalations?
open_items.owner_direction: Owner-confirmed on 2026-11-01: better means more everyday tasks completed correctly with fewer corrections, across the whole of daily life rather than one domain. No ordering between those goals was agreed and none is invented here.

open_items.item: May interaction data become evaluation fixtures, and under what consent and de-identification rules?

open_items.decision: Yes - all inference, memory, voice processing and call summaries are local on the dedicated server (O-1, O-2).

open_items.item: Jurisdiction, disclosure and recording-consent rules for telephony, including two-party consent regions.
Which people-database fields may be stored at all (relationship notes? health notes?).
Which languages are in the target matrix, in what order, and what is the fluency bar beyond the 90% turn-success threshold? (PR-1 proposes fifteen; the owner has not chosen)
open_items.proposal: PR-1 (fifteen languages) is a proposal, not the owner's list; the order and the fluency bar remain the owner's to set.
open_items.owner_direction: Owner-confirmed on 2026-11-01: multilingual support is required (O-4). The list, the order and the fluency bar are not settled; PR-1 is offered as a starting point only.

open_items.item: What server hardware and budget are approved, and what is the acceptable electrical/noise footprint?
open_items.proposal: PR-2 (capacity tiers) is a proposal, not an approved budget or purchase; G-O1 stays blocked and no model, vendor or hardware is named.
open_items.owner_direction: Owner-confirmed on 2026-11-01: a dedicated server hosts everything (O-1). Capacity, budget, electrical and noise constraints are not settled.

open_items.item: Which accounts and devices are in scope for connectors, and which scopes may be granted to each?
What are the default call-handling modes and escalation triggers?
Approve, amend or reject proposed policy P-1 (blanket refusal of financial, medical and legal call actions).
Which smart-home devices and protocols are owned today, and is a local hub acceptable?
Update latency is tolerable (days to weeks for gated changes).
A human owner exists for approvals.
open_items.decision: The owner is engaged and has issued decisions O-1..O-7; formal confirmation of the approval workload is still requested.

open_items.item: Phase 8 assigns B4 memory, B5 multimodal, B6 voice, B7 adversarial; the Stage 0 M2 note describes B4 voice, B5 memory, B6 latency, B7 long-horizon.
open_items.decision: Resolved in M5 by docs/product/family-crosswalk.md: the Phase 8 numbering (B4 memory, B5 multimodal, B6 voice, B7 adversarial) is authoritative and retained; the Stage-0 M2/M3 labels are superseded by name only, and their evidence is unchanged. Long-horizon behaviour, formerly called B7, is preserved as a named future suite rather than an acceptance criterion.

open_items.item: EDITH Glass: what hardware, software, cost and timeline does the owner want, and is the project pursued at all?
open_items.note: Owner-confirmed as a separate future project (O-11); no requirement exists yet and none is invented.

open_items.item: Which rooms and surfaces are in scope for the home holographic interface, and what optical, power and space constraints does the home impose?
open_items.note: The interface is specified independently of the space it will occupy; nothing about the owner's home is assumed.

proposed_policies.policy: Blanket refusal of all financial, medical and legal call actions
proposed_policies.note: Not an owner-confirmed requirement. Safeguards that apply regardless: speaker verification, scope-limited authority, tier-2 confirmation, escalation by default, and legal/jurisdiction rules.

evaluation_backlog.status_statement: Planning only, plus four evaluator suites. B4 has three slices: metadata/expiry (12 task fixtures), deletion with backup/restore (27 task fixtures) and a synthetic write-ahead-log durability store (10 task fixtures); B16 has one (12 task fixtures). Sixteen families are planned and none is implemented; no capability is validated, and no slice changes a capability status.

sample_counts.note: deterministic executions, not independent samples; the scripted interruptions, partial writes, retries and damaged backups are scenarios, not a distribution over restore implementations

slices.status: implemented evaluator slice (deletion drills, backup restore, evaluator-injected interruptions between records and inside a record write, damaged backups; not the family, not a product memory system)

sample_counts.note: deterministic executions, not independent samples: each crash lands at one fixed byte, every scenario runs once, and no confidence interval is implied or may be computed from these counts

slices.status: implemented evaluator slice (a synthetic WAL store in a temporary directory, crash points chosen by the evaluator at deterministic byte offsets, recovery from on-disk bytes only; not the family, not a product memory system)

proposals.summary: A proposed working set of fifteen languages, offered as a starting point for Q19. The owner has not set the list, the order or the fluency bar, and no language is claimed to work. Every entry is 'not measured'.

no order of delivery is proposed here - that is Q19 and the owner's
the bar stays the C-03 turn-success threshold plus a per-language fluency review that the owner still has to define
a language's presence in this list is not a commitment to build it

proposals.summary: A proposed shape for the dedicated server, expressed as capacity tiers rather than products. No model, vendor, accelerator or purchase is selected; G-O1 stays blocked and Q20 stays open.

properties: separate fast local storage for the system, the models and the data
wired network to the home network, not wireless, for the server itself
an uninterruptible power supply sized to shut the server down cleanly
encrypted local backups with a tested restore, kept on a separate device
all processing stays on this server (O-1, O-2); no cloud inference at any tier
